title: WorkloadReceipt
description: Evidence record for a single workload execution through a DePIN adapter. Distinguishes between locally observed, node-signed, independently verified, and provider-acknowledged evidence. Does not establish token rewards.

receiptId.description: Hex-encoded 24-byte random ID unique to this receipt.

nodeFingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the node's public key.

operationId.description: Scoped operation ID from the node-agent command that authorized this workload.

observationIntervalSeconds.description: Wall-clock duration of the measured interval.

workloadDigest.description: SHA-256 digest of the workload artifact (binary, image, or script) used.

jobCommitment.description: Optional: commitment to the job spec. Present for proof workloads.

inputDigest.description: Optional: SHA-256 of the input payload.

outputDigest.description: Optional: SHA-256 of the output payload.

measurementSource.description: What produced the measurement (e.g. kernel-netdev-counters, process-stdout, prover-binary).

measuredValue.description: Raw measured values with units. Schema depends on adapter operation kind.

evidenceLevel.description: Highest evidence level achieved. A signed local counter is not independent proof. A computation proof does not establish bandwidth delivery or physical truth.

providerAcknowledgement.description: Present only when the external provider confirmed the contribution. Not inferred from local measurements.

onChainReference.description: Optional on-chain anchor. Never inferred from local data.

nodeSignature.description: Base64 Ed25519 signature by the node's identity key over the canonical receipt bytes (JCS of all fields except this one).

trustAssumptions.description: Explicit trust assumptions the verifier must accept. Never empty.

isQualificationFixture.description: True when this receipt was produced by a local qualification fixture rather than a live external provider. Must never be presented as real provider contribution.

fixtureLabel.description: Required when isQualificationFixture=true. Human-readable label explaining the fixture context.
